questions.prompt: How do you create an image from a running container?
questions.explanation: lxc publish <instance> --alias <name> creates a new image from the instance's current state.

questions.prompt: What must you do before publishing a container as an image?
options: Stop the container (for containers, not VMs)
questions.answer: Stop the container (for containers, not VMs)
questions.explanation: Containers must be stopped before publishing. VMs can sometimes be published while running.

questions.prompt: How do you create an image from a snapshot instead of the live instance?
options: lxc snapshot publish web clean --alias clean-image
questions.explanation: Use the instance/snapshot syntax: lxc publish web/clean --alias clean-image creates an image from the snapshot.

questions.prompt: How do you launch a new instance from a custom image alias 'my-web-image'?
questions.explanation: lxc launch <alias> <name> creates a new instance from a local image alias.
